title: [Feature Request]: Implement Wikipedia Agent
body:
### Is your feature request related to a problem? Please describe.

Encapsulate wikipedia tools in an agent that encapsulates various Wikipedia tools and determines which tool(s) to use based on the problem context.

Wikipedia Tools (#1367):
- WikipediaQueryRunTool: Returns summary of a list of pages returned from search query
- WikipediaPageLoadTool: Returns full text of a list of pages returned from search query
